LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Title: Download server modpack
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Prepare: Checking modpack access and installed mods…
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Retire: Previous managed copies to replace: {0}. They will be kept for rollback.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Policy: Server sign-in: {0}. Downloading does not create an account or bypass authentication. Extra gameplay mods will be disabled; their folders will stay.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Consent: I trust the server owner and agree to download, verify and enable these mods. Mods may execute code. The game will restart once after installation.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.SettingsConsent: I agree to use the complete server settings set. My personal settings will be kept separately.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Restored: The previous files and mod list have been restored. Restart the game before joining again.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Unavailable: The server has no compatible published package. Ask its administrator to prepare the complete redistributable collection, or install the mods manually.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.SteamOnly: This server permits Steam sign-in only. Installing mods will not add GOG sign-in. Its administrator must enable login and password separately.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.TrustRefused: The server certificate was not confirmed. Sign-in data was not sent.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Redirect: The server redirects the download to another address. Redirected downloads are refused.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Unauthorized: Download access expired, was revoked, or the server password is wrong. Start again; the verified partial file may be resumed.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Expired: Permission expired. Start the operation again.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.StaleCatalog: The administrator changed the modpack or its settings. Review and confirm the new collection.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Busy: Another installation is running or the server is busy. Try later.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.RateLimit: Too many requests. Wait a minute.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Conflict: A different unmanaged copy of a mod is installed. Rimlink will not replace it. Close the game and resolve this conflict manually:
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Duplicate: Several copies of one mod were found. Close the game and keep the required copy:
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.LoadedMod: A replacement needs to remove a mod whose assembly is loaded by this game. Automatic replacement is refused; close the game and update it manually:
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.ExternalChange: Files changed during the operation. Both versions were kept; automatic replacement is refused:
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.RecoveryRequired: An installation is unfinished. Use “Roll back installation” in the server list. Manually changed files or loaded assemblies may require closing the game and resolving the conflict. Sign-in is blocked until recovery.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.RestartRequired: Files were rolled back. Restart the game before joining so its loaded mods and settings match the restored files.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.DiskSpace: Not enough room for the archive, extracted files and backups. Free space on the game and profile drives.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.HashMismatch: The checksum differs. The damaged package was not installed.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.InvalidRange: The server returned an invalid resume response. The package was not installed.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.UnsafePath: The archive or directory contains an unsafe path or link. Installation stopped.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Limit: A size or file-count limit was exceeded. Installation stopped.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Prerequisite: The required Core or DLC version is missing. Install it from your own game copy; the server does not distribute it.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.PreparedMismatch: Prepared files do not match the server requirements. Restart cancelled.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.InstalledMismatch: The installed mod files or settings changed after installation. Sign-in stopped; backups are kept. Check the files or roll back the installation. The game will not restart again automatically.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Storage: Could not read or write files. Check free space, permissions and locked files.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Unknown: Installation stopped ({0}). Original files were kept; check the Rimlink log.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Consent: The administrator must confirm redistribution rights and availability without a server password.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.SettingsConsent: Distribution of the complete shared settings set was not confirmed.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Incomplete: The package is incomplete. The administrator must include all required mods and dependencies.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Dependency: A dependency is missing or loads in the wrong order. Ask the administrator to correct the package.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Incompatible: The package contains incompatible mods. Ask the administrator to correct the collection.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.Order: Load order conflicts with mod metadata. Ask the administrator to correct it.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.GameVersion: The package is not intended for this RimWorld version.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.InvalidConfig: ModsConfig.xml could not be parsed safely. The original file was kept.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.ForbiddenContent: The package contains game, personal or service files that must not be distributed.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Delivery.Error.NotFound: The package no longer exists. Fetch the current server requirements.
